statement: Pinned Linux v6.12 classifies a Nintendo RVL-CNT-01, 057e:0306 Wii Remote as gen10 rather than gen20 or gen15, then schedules four-second MotionPlus hotplug polling because gen10 has no BUILTIN_MP flag. Its A600FA/6 probe recognizes a six-byte reply ending 0x05 regardless of the earlier built-in versus external identity bytes. On a responding early integrated Plus this can create the MotionPlus evdev child while devtype remains gen10; it does not prove a captured physical response.

applicability.revision: Linux v6.12 Gen 1 name/ID classifier and MotionPlus hotplug; early 0306 retail response not measured
applicability.scope: evidence_role: consumer. Linux v6.12 core 513-530,582-605,811-905,907-933,1100-1179; modules 2630-2665. No hardware or host run.
